verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS AI code-review service, so the axis applies. The privacy and security docs cover SOC 2 Type 1, a no-training commitment from model providers, and an option to block AI features, but nothing about selecting a storage region or residency. Those are adjacent privacy controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
